entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and the order number?
Of course. The name is Anya Sharma, and the order was VF-881-2940.

Thank you, Anya. I see your order here, delivered 17 days ago on January 9th. I also see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device or a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... so hard to use. Honestly, I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I really expected more. It's all so confusing. I feel like I've read the user manual a dozen times and I still can't figure out the main screen when I'm riding.

I see. I appreciate you clarifying that for me. I do need to let you know upfront that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to its activation and hygiene protocols. Since we're at day 17, a return for a refund isn't something I can process.

Oh. I... I didn't know it was different. I really needed this money back for some other bills. I saved up for this, and now I'm just stuck with something I can't use. This is just really disheartening.

I completely understand the frustration, and I don't want you to be stuck with a product you're not enjoying. Let's not give up on it just yet. You mentioned the main screen is confusing while you're riding. Can you tell me a bit more about what you're seeing?

It's just a jumble of numbers that change constantly. I only wanted to see my heart rate and cadence, but there are all these other metrics and graphs. It's impossible to focus on the two things I actually care about.

Ah, that is a very common point of confusion right out of the box, and I apologize that the user manual wasn't clearer on this. That's actually a customizable display. We can fix that for you in about 30 seconds. Do you have your phone handy?
You can change it? Okay, yes, I have my phone right here.

Great. Please open the VeloFit app, go to the 'Devices' tab, and tap on your VeloBand Pulse. From there, you should see an option for 'Display Settings' or 'Customize Screen'. If you tap that, you can drag and drop the metrics you want to see and remove the ones you don't.

Okay, one second... Devices... VeloBand Pulse... oh, 'Display Settings'! I see it. Wow, I can just turn off the 'Power Zones' and 'Lap Time'... and just keep Heart Rate and Cadence. Let me save this... Oh my goodness. That's... that's exactly what I wanted.
Perfect. Does that resolve the issue for you?
Yes! It completely does. I feel a bit silly now. Thank you so much, I was so ready to just put this back in the box. This is much, much better.

Not at all, it's our job to make sure you can enjoy the gear. I'm very glad we could get that sorted out. And for the initial frustration and to thank you for your loyalty as a VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase. You'll see that reflected in an email shortly.
You really didn't have to do that, but thank you, Isaac. You've been incredibly helpful. You completely turned my day around.
It's my pleasure, Anya. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
